name: services/feedback/status
description: This module is in early BETA state. As such, it is not enabled by default. You should allowed the users to submit feedback only when it is enabled!

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of the following format:

  • enabled - boolean, true if the module is enabled, and there is a chance that the submitted reports are read by someone.
